**High Quality beta nicotinamide mononucleotide nmn for anti aging bulk powder**
**High Quality beta nicotinamide mononucleotide nmn for anti aging bulk powder**  
Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Powder (NMN) is a watersoluble vitamin, The product is white crystalline powder, odorless or nearly odorless, bitter in taste, freely soluble in water or ethanol, dissolvable in glycerin. NMN is a chemical that is found in some fruits and vegetables. It can have on the aging process.Nicotinamide mononucleotide plays an important role in human cell energy production. It is involved in the synthesis of intracellular NAD(nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, an important coenzyme for cell energy transformation).Artificial supplementation of NMN can repair brain injury, improve islet function, protect the heart from ischemia-reperfusion injury, repair brain mitochondrial respiratory defects, and has certain therapeutic effects on senile degenerative diseases, retinal degenerative diseases, type 2 diabetes, cerebral hemorrhage, etc.
